ana (auditor): Hi team, need evidence for the RBAC change deployed yesterday that mitigated CVE-2026-0421. Request: PR/commit link, approval timestamps, terraform plan+apply diff, KMS CMK id/alias, CloudTrail events (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey) for 1h before -> 2h after canary, and a signed chain-of-custody for the artifact bundle. Also who can call kms:Decrypt (roles/policies).

leo (sec): Acknowledged. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinfra/infra-iam/pull/261 commit e7a9c2f. Approvals: @sec_lead 2026-04-02T05:12:01Z, @platform 2026-04-02T05:18:30Z. We'll produce the terraform diff and a roles CSV.

jamal (infra): CMK alias=alias/redwood-prod-kms, key-id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-000111222333. No rotation during window (last rotation 2025-12-01). Commands I'll run and attach sanitized outputs:
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z --end-time 2026-04-02T08:00:00Z --query Events

maya (oncall): Canary started 2026-04-02T05:30Z; brief 503 spike on inference-2 between 05:34-05:38Z, rollback tested then continued. No auth failures seen. INF-2026-712.

evidence-bot: export job created -> s3://redwood-evidence/exports/1965432100-rbac-kms-bundle-20260402.tar.gz (presigned link valid 7d). Uploader: infra-ci@redwood.

ana (auditor): Need SHA256 of tarball and a GPG-signed manifest plus S3 access log path showing any GETs. Also a short signed attestation from @sec_lead confirming minimal-privilege rationale.

leo (sec): Will generate SHA256, sign manifest with release key, and add attestation. ETA ~90m. Posting final bundle link and manifest here when ready. :white_check_mark:
